editorial:
Imagine starting a movie with a dead body at a big dance competition in Blackpool. That is exactly how things kick off here, and it immediately gets you wondering what went wrong. You get to follow Tove and Claes, a couple who dance together but clearly cannot stand each other. Their relationship is full of fights and hidden anger, which makes every dance scene feel like a battle. Then you have Liselott and Lennart, who are supposed to be their friends and rivals, but they end up stirring the pot even more. The whole vibe is very tense, making you feel like something bad is bound to happen while everyone tries to keep up a fake smile for the judges.

What really works here is how the movie builds up the pressure. The acting is solid and makes you feel the stress of the competition. While the pace is a bit slow at times, the mystery of whether it was an accident or a crime keeps you watching. If you enjoy dramas where people pretend to be happy while hating each other, you will love this. You should definitely check it out by renting it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: The movie reveals that the death was not a simple accident. The tension between Tove and Claes finally snaps, leading to a tragic moment of violence. It turns out the emotional abuse and the pressure to win drove them to a breaking point. The final scenes show the fallout of their toxic relationship, leaving you to realize that their obsession with perfection and dancing destroyed their lives completely.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological mysteries and stories about toxic relationships.
